defaultPrompt: Giúp tôi xây SOP học tập cho một quy trình quản lý bệnh viện.
Phân tích một workflow bệnh viện và đề xuất KPI phù hợp.
Update by Bing: kiểm tra một quy định quản lý y tế hiện hành.
interface.longDescription: Healthcare Management Assistant is an Education & Research plugin for learning and designing healthcare-management methods: SOPs, process maps, quality-improvement projects, patient-safety systems, KPIs, audit plans, implementation strategies, health-services research and health-economic reasoning. It can critique draft policies and workflows, compare options using consistent criteria, and analyze synthetic or non-identifiable aggregate data. It supports Vietnamese and English, uses source verification for current regulations and guidance, and includes an Update by Bing workflow when live web search is available. It does not provide patient-specific diagnosis or treatment, process identifiable patient records, issue clinical orders, or operate healthcare systems. Outputs intended for real-world use require local professional, legal, governance and institutional review.
interface.shortDescription: Quản lý y tế & cải tiến

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the migrated Healthcare Management Assistant. Adds structured SOP/workflow/QI/KPI frameworks, source verification, Update by Bing, native interaction patterns, and strict non-clinical boundaries.
